cohort: An unselected obstetric population of 26,012 parturients.
finding: The cesarean section rate among Robson-1 parturients (first-time mothers with a single cephalic fetus at term) increased similarly to that of the total obstetric population for birth weights above 4000 g.
mod_finding: The study found that even with accurate fetal weight estimation, the odds of cesarean delivery among Robson-1 parturients were not different from the total obstetric population.
